name: Modern Welding Company of Kentucky
old_description: At Modern Welding Company, we take pride in delivering innovative, high-quality tank storage solutions across a wide range of industries. Our Project Stories highlight the depth of our expertise—from advanced fuel storage systems to complex custom fabrication projects. Each project reflects our commitment to engineering excellence, quality craftsmanship, and our ability to meet unique customer requirements. Explore our work to see how we bring precision, reliability, and performance to every solution we deliver.
about:
Modern Welding Company of Kentucky, Inc. operates from Elizabethtown, Kentucky, tracing its roots to June 1932 when John G. Barnard — known as “Mr. Pete” — opened a small job shop in Owensboro. The family-owned business expanded steadily, acquiring plants across the Midwest and South, and by 2022 marked 90 years of continuous operation.

The company manufactures underground and aboveground steel storage tanks, ASME-code pressure vessels, and LPG tanks for flammable and combustible liquids and gases. Its Elizabethtown facility specializes in custom plate work, chute fabrication, wear products, and structural steel fabrication. Modern Welding runs ten tank and vessel fabrication subsidiaries nationwide, two dedicated structural steel plants, and four welding supply stores in Kentucky and Indiana, all linked by a shared information network.

Customers span energy, construction, distillery, agriculture, defense, mining, chemical processing, and petroleum storage. Documented projects include a refinery deisohexanizer tower, UL-142 emergency fuel tanks installed within a hospital footprint, high-capacity fuel storage for a global agribusiness, and bulk propane tanks for poultry facility heating.

Modern Welding positions itself as the largest U.S. supplier of UL-listed steel storage tanks. Its quality program encompasses ASME, NBIC, AWS, AISC, UL, STI, and API standards, and the Elizabethtown plant holds AISC Certified Fabricator status. The company emphasizes domestic production, a regional subsidiary model for faster delivery, and a guaranteed 24-hour quote turnaround.
